title: Saddle Time
specs: Experienced instructor with lifelong passion for horses
Focus on safety, riding skills, and horsemanship
Minimum age 7 for regular lessons; ages 4 and up for low pressure horse experience
Appropriate riding attire required for continuing lessons: paddock boots, half chaps, riding pants, ASTM approved helmet, riding gloves
Parent or legal guardian must sign liability release for camps
Discounted rates sometimes available for home school groups
includes: Instruction on grooming, tacking, and riding
Formal riding instruction and general horsemanship in camps
gap: Exact lesson duration not stated (approximate 1 hour inferred)
blurb: Saddle Time offers beginner through advanced English riding lessons for children and adults. Lessons include instruction on grooming, tacking, and riding skills. They also offer horse camps for children ages 7-12 focused on riding and horsemanship.
extraNote: Lessons require minimum once per week attendance · Cancellation: notify instructor to reschedule; rescheduling subject to availability; no charge if instructor cancels due to weather or illness · Camp deposit $200 refundable only if camp is cancelled due to weather; otherwise non-refundable · 900 N 53rd, Broken Arrow, OK (behind 71st Mini Storage business)
